tax.text: Lee opposed raising federal tax rates and said she supports exempting tips and overtime from taxation.
tax.quote: I support policies like no tax on tips and no tax on overtime

trade.text: Lee said President Trump’s tariffs harmed Nevada through reduced tourism and higher home costs.
trade.quote: Lee: Yes. Lee blamed tariffs for the sharp decline in Canadian tourists visiting Las Vegas last year and the general tourism slump, as well as for higher home costs .

debt.text: Lee opposed raising the Social Security retirement age and supported addressing the program’s finances without cutting benefits.
debt.quote: She supports solutions that don't involve cutting benefits

housing.text: Lee supported legislation intended to increase housing supply and lower housing costs.
housing.quote: We need to build more housing families can afford.

schools.text: Lee introduced legislation to fully fund federal programs for public school districts and support wraparound services in public schools.
schools.quote: I introduced legislation to fully fund Title I and the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act.

immigration.text: Supported bipartisan immigration reform that would strengthen border security and provide earned legal-status pathways, while supporting deportation for immigrants who commit crimes.
immigration.quote: Lee noted her support for the Dignity Act , a bipartisan immigration reform bill that aims to strengthen border security and provide earned pathways to legal status for many individuals, including Dreamers.

guns.text: Lee said she helped pass the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act and supports additional gun-safety measures.
guns.quote: I worked across the aisle to pass the historic Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. But it is not enough.

abortion.text: Lee supports codifying Roe-era protections and protecting access to abortion and other reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: I won’t rest until every woman has the freedom to make private reproductive and health care decisions about her own body.

health.text: Lee supported extending Affordable Care Act premium tax credits and opposed Medicaid cuts.
health.quote: Lee: Yes. Lee co-sponsored a bipartisan bill to extend the tax credits

energy.text: Lee said she is working to combat climate change and expand clean-energy production, including through the Inflation Reduction Act.
energy.quote: I’m doing everything possible to protect our public lands and parks, combat climate change, and build our clean energy economy.

voting.text: Lee opposed the SAVE America Act, arguing that its proof-of-citizenship requirements would disenfranchise voters and create barriers to registration.
voting.quote: She called the bill "an attempt by the Trump administration to disenfranchise millions of Americans,"

tax.text: O'Donnell has pledged to oppose income-tax increases and called for reducing federal program budgets.
tax.quote: We cannot continue to spend like drunken sailors. We can't continue to increase the budgets and tax the people. It's just unacceptable.

trade.text: O'Donnell said tariffs can protect national security, support U.S. jobs and help American businesses.
trade.quote: President Trump uses tariffs as a form of diplomacy to level the playing field on trade or to protect our national security,” O'Donnell wrote.

debt.text: O’Donnell opposed raising the Social Security retirement age above 67 and said the national debt should be addressed without leaving holes in social safety nets.
debt.quote: O'Donnell: No. O'Donnell's campaign website emphasizes the need to address the national debt to avoid leaving social safety nets "with giant holes in them."

housing.text: O'Donnell supports unlocking federal land for development to increase housing supply and reduce housing costs.
housing.quote: We need to unlock federal land for development, but we should do it over a shorter period of time than this bill allows,” O'Donnell said.

immigration.text: O’Donnell said undocumented immigrants who commit additional crimes while in the United States should be deported.
immigration.quote: All illegal immigrants who have committed additional crimes while in the United States should be deported

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: O’Donnell said that allowing boys to participate in girls’ sports should stop.
gender.quote: You know, transing your kids, boys in girls' sports, having open borders, the ever-growing federal government and fraud, that all has to stop

health.text: O'Donnell opposes reinstating enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies and calls for broader health care reform instead.
health.quote: Reinstating these subsidies won't fix our healthcare system that Democrats broke,

voting.text: O'Donnell supported passage of the SAVE America Act, which would require proof of citizenship for federal voter registration.
